_readme: Six premises for `npm run story:bench` (scripts/story-bench.mjs).
WHY EACH ONE CARRIES ITS OWN BEATS. This repository has NO premise-to-outline
step. POST /api/nvm/converge and /api/nvm/converge-arc both require a
SceneTarget[] (server/nvm/generate/proof-spec.ts: sceneIdx, sceneFunction,
activeMechanisms, tensionTarget, themeHint) from the caller; the Story wizard
produces a StoryConfig and stops; nothing anywhere turns a paragraph of
English into a beat sheet. So the `beats` array below is HAND-AUTHORED, and
the bench says so in every run it prints. It is scaffolding for the
measurement, not a product feature, and a reader must not take the structure
the bench produces as structure the product derived.
The premises are written for this fixture (no existing property, no real
person). Six shapes on purpose: a large cast, a two-hander, a comedy, a
non-linear structure, an animation-shaped family film, and a thriller.
WHY EACH PREMISE ALSO CARRIES A `cast`. IntentionalProof (a Tier 1 proof, so it
BLOCKS a commit) fails any op that references a character with no belief in
state and none introduced by the same IR. A fresh session has no characters, so
the first run of this bench had every scene of every premise rejected at
POST /api/nvm/converge/commit. The product has no premise-to-cast step either,
so the cast is fixture data too: the bench prepends one UPDATE_BELIEF per
member to the FIRST committed scene, which grounds them for every later scene
and puts them in buildSystemPreamble's "known characters" list. It is the same
kind of scaffolding as the beats, disclosed the same way.
WHY THE MECHANISM NAMES LOOK LIKE THAT. `activeMechanisms` is NOT free text.
MechanismProof is a Tier 1 proof and it BLOCKS a commit whose IR names a
mechanism with no matching server/nvm/mechanisms/<id>.mech.json. That
directory holds exactly SIX: clue_cascade, false_purpose,
identity_performance, legitimacy_split, object_burden and
relationship_externalization. The first version of this fixture used
story-shaped names ("confinement", "deception", "deadline") and every scene
of every premise was rejected at POST /api/nvm/converge/commit with
"unknown mechanism ... no matching .mech.json". Nothing in the product
surfaces that vocabulary to a caller; the test beside this file pins it.

premises.title: HARBOR LIGHTS
premises.theme: What a town owes the people who keep it running
premises.premise: The night the cannery announces it is closing, eleven people in a small fishing harbour each decide, separately, what they will do about it: the foreman who has the closure letter and has not opened it, the harbourmaster who has been quietly selling moorings, the two sisters who run the only diner, a deckhand with a fake certificate, the priest who knows about the certificate, a shipping agent down from the city, a teenager who has already packed, the mechanic who will not leave, the mayor who negotiated the deal, and the foreman's wife, who tells him to open the letter.
premises.characters: TOMAS (foreman), NELL (his wife), DRU (harbourmaster), THE SISTERS, KAI (deckhand), FATHER ORR, MS. AVERY (agent), JUNE (teenager), BASS (mechanic), MAYOR LOCK

beats.themeHint: the mayor's deal is named out loud
the meeting at the cannery gate

cast.believes: the letter can still be unopened tomorrow
Tomas has to open it tonight
nobody knows about the moorings
the certificate will hold
the certificate is a sin worth keeping quiet
the deal was the only deal there was

premises.title: COUNTERWEIGHT
premises.theme: Whether being right is worth being alone
premises.premise: A structural engineer and the building inspector who condemned her bridge are trapped together overnight in the inspection gantry beneath it, 40 metres above a river, after the access lift fails. She has eleven hours to persuade him the calculation he rejected was correct; he has eleven hours to make her admit she already knew it wasn't. Neither can leave, and the tide is coming in beneath them.

beats.themeHint: the first version of the story
the notebook page she did not submit
what they sign in the morning

cast.believes: the calculation was right and the bridge is safe
she knew the calculation was wrong when she filed it

premises.title: THE UNDERSTUDY CLAUSE
premises.premise: A regional theatre's insurance policy pays out only if a production opens, so when the lead breaks both wrists the day before press night, the company manager quietly promotes the understudy — who is the box-office clerk, who cannot act, and who has been signing the lead's autographs for two years. The critic arrives early. The real lead arrives in a taxi. The insurance assessor is already in seat F12 and has been told nothing.
premises.characters: PRUE BALLANTYNE (manager), OZ KETTLE (clerk/understudy), MARGUERITE VANE (lead), HOLLIS (critic), MR. DAWE (assessor)

cast.believes: the insurance pays only if the curtain goes up
he can be believed for one night
the part is hers whatever the hospital says
something about the lead is wrong
the claim is straightforward

premises.title: NINE MINUTES OF TAPE
premises.theme: An account is not the same thing as the truth
premises.premise: Nine minutes of a hotel corridor's security tape are missing from the night a translator disappeared. The film assembles the evening out of order — the last scene chronologically comes first, the first comes last — from four accounts that agree on everything except who was holding the room key. Each retelling restores a little more of the tape, and the final fragment shows something none of the four described.
premises.characters: MIRA HALVE (translator), ANSEL (night manager), DET. RUTH OKONJO, PAOLO (guest), THE KEY

beats.themeHint: the end, told first: the corridor at 3am

cast.believes: the key was never hers to give back
he handed the key over at midnight
one of the four accounts is a lie
he never touched the key

premises.title: THE LONG WAY ROUND
premises.theme: Home is a direction, not a place
premises.premise: A migrating crane chick who cannot navigate is separated from her flock over a city and takes up with a rooftop pigeon who has never flown further than four blocks and claims, loudly, to know the way south. Their route is wrong in every particular, and it works — because the pigeon's four blocks are full of people, awnings, cables and updrafts he understands completely, and the crane's instinct for distance is exactly what he lacks.
premises.characters: PEEP (crane chick), GUTTER (pigeon), THE FLOCK, A WINDOW CLEANER, THE KESTREL

beats.themeHint: the kestrel on the water tower
the updraft he has always used

cast.believes: south is a direction she can feel
he knows the way south
the small one is easy prey

premises.title: COLD OPEN
premises.premise: A live overnight radio host takes a call from a man who describes, calmly and in verifiable detail, a murder that has not been reported. Her producer says it is a hoax. The police say it is a hoax. The caller says he will call back at four, and that by then she will have checked the one detail he gave that only the killer could know. She has ninety minutes of airtime and a studio door that locks from the inside.
premises.characters: VIC SANDOVAL (host), TERE (producer), THE CALLER, DET. LOWE, THE NIGHT SECURITY GUARD

beats.themeHint: the studio at one in the morning

cast.believes: the caller is telling the truth
it is a hoax and the show has to go on
she will check the detail before four
there is no body, so there is no case
